column1: #  - a top-level equation is a function, once however many equations it has: f x = .., f = .., an operator (a |+| b = ..) and a back-quoted one (x `plus` y = ..). The type signature is not a definition of its own, and a point-free value (total = sum . map area) is a function too, because without type inference it cannot be told from one;
#  - data, newtype and data family are classes; type synonyms and type families are type aliases; class is an interface and the signatures in its body are methods; record fields are fields;
#  - instance bodies, where/let bindings, data constructors, pattern synonyms and `type instance` are not definitions.
